svg.title: Style spec: row anatomy, type scale and colour roles
svg.desc: Mock: the proposed sidebar rows with numbered parts, the type scale at real size, and the colour roles from the Hutan packs. Invented data.
svg.text: Row anatomy at 1.6×: name first, one state lane, news only when there is news
own harness monogram 14 pt (π OMP, asterisk Claude Code, ring Codex, bubble direct chat,
prompt for a shell) with an 8 pt state badge at its top-right, knocked out by a 1.5 pt ring of the
`fg` regular, semibold while a finished turn is unread, `faint` once the session ended. Always
the strongest text of the row; cut with “…”, never wraps.
`faint`, right aligned; on hover it gives way to fork (⑂) and close (×), 14 pt Bold, no extra row
only when something is going on: needs-you question (`warn`), failure (`danger`), the tool now
running, or the first line of an unread reply. Model chip in mono 9.5 pt on `surface_hover`,
radius 4. Idle or read rows are one line.
28 pt one line, 44 pt with a news line; 8 pt side inset; hover and selected are fills (radius 8),
never outlines; sessions indent 16 pt under a project, 32 pt under a worktree.
Type scale (real size, system sans; mono = terminal family)
Colour roles (existing tokens, docs/design.md; no new colours)
